41000.synonym: ajjhāvasanta, paribbasāna, vasanta, vasamāna, vasita, vāsūpagata, viharanta, sammanta

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasantassa sākete kiñci'd'eva accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ uppajjeyya. tassa antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca sāketaṃ satta rathavinītāni upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ.

41003.meaning1: blows against the wind; spreads against the wind

examples.text: na pupphagandho paṭivātam'eti, na candanaṃ tagaramallikā, satañ'ca gandho paṭivātam'eti, sabbā disā sappuriso pavāyati.

41004.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of paṭivāta
41004.meaning1: against the wind; into the wind; windward
41004.commentary: (ANa) na pupphagandho paṭivātam'etī'ti vassikapupph'ādīnaṃ gandho paṭivātaṃ na gacchati.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, puriso ādittaṃ tiṇ'ukkaṃ ādāya paṭivātaṃ gaccheyya.
yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati, suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa, tam'eva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ, sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃ'va khitto.

41005.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of paṭivāta

examples.text: sīlagandhasamo gandho, kuto nāma bhavissati, yo samaṃ anuvāte ca, paṭivāte ca vāyati.

ye'pi nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā te'pi nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu nibbinnarūpā virattarūpā paṭivānarūpā yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe.

41008.meaning1: withdraws; pulls back; makes turn away (from)
41008.commentary: (ANa) paṭivāpetī'ti nibbānavasena nivatteti. (ANa) cittaṃ paṭivāpetī'ti cittaṃ paṭisaṃharati moceti apaneti.

examples.text: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati

41009.meaning1: having withdrawn; having pulled back; having made turn away

examples.text: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udake lekhā khippaṃ'y'eva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo āgāḷhena'pi vuccamāno pharusena'pi vuccamāno amanāpena'pi vuccamāno sandhiyati'm'eva saṃsandati'm'eva sammodati'm'eva.
tuliya paṭivicaya cintayitvā, mahājanasaṅgahanaṃ samekkhamāno, ayam'idam'arahati tattha tattha, purisavisesakaro pure ahosi.

41012.meaning1: examines; investigates; considers carefully; (comm) wanders around for the purpose of questioning
41012.commentary: (ANa) na ca paṭivicarantī'ti pucchan'atthāya cārikaṃ na vicaranti.

examples.text: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā aññam'aññaṃ paṭipucchanti paṭivicaranti, idaṃ kathaṃ, imassa ko attho'ti? te avivaṭañ'c'eva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañ'ca uttānīkaronti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, soṇa, vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahaṃ, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
evaṃ abhisaddahati, ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ, ten'āhaṃ eta'r'ahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca paṭivijjha passāmī'ti.
pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirass'eva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati. katamehi pañcahi?

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ānanda, katamaṃ nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā, yo dūrato'va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanaṃ atipāteyya poṅkh'ānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ, yo vā sattadhā bhinnassa vālassa koṭiyā koṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyā'ti?
atha kho, ānanda, duppaṭivijjhataraṃ paṭivijjhanti, ye idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhanti … ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhanti.

41019.commentary: (SNa) sattadhā bhinnassa vālassa koṭiyā koṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyā'ti ekaṃ vālaṃ sattadhā bhinditvā, tassa ekaṃ bhedaṃ gahetvā, vātiṅgaṇamajjhe bandhitvā, aparaṃ bhedaṃ kaṇḍassa aggakoṭiyaṃ bandhitvā, usabhamatte ṭhito kaṇḍabaddhāya koṭiyā taṃ vātiṅgaṇabaddhakoṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyā'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā soṇo aparena samayena vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhāsi, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjhi, tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.

41022.meaning1: should be penetrated; should be comprehended; should be understood
41022.meaning2: should be penetrated; should be pierced
41022.commentary: (MNa) taṃ kho pana vo anuruddhā nimittaṃ paṭivijjhitabban'ti taṃ vo kāraṇaṃ jānitabbaṃ.

examples.text: taṃ kho pana vo, anuruddhā, nimittaṃ paṭivijjhitabbaṃ.

41023.meaning1: to comprehend; to understand; to penetrate
41023.meaning2: to comprehend; to understand; to penetrate

examples.text: evam'pi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne n'āsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ, na bhagavantaṃ yāci, tiṭṭhatu, bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti, yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
nibbijjhā'ti paṭivijjhitvā. sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti paṭivijjhitvā, sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā'ti paṭivijjhitvā… yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti paṭivijjhitvā.
paramadanto'ti aññena kenaci asikkhāpito acodito sayambhuñāṇena paṭivijjhitvā paramadamathena dantattā paramadanto nāma. parinibbuto'ti kilesaparinibbānena parinibbuto.

41026.commentary: (PMa) paṭividitā'ti abhimukhabhāvena viditā pākaṭā nāma honti. tena paṭisambhidāpadassa attho vutto.

examples.text: añño saddh'indriyaṃ dhammo, añño vīriy'indriyaṃ dhammo, añño sat'indriyaṃ dhammo, añño samādh'indriyaṃ dhammo, añño paññ'indriyaṃ dhammo. yena ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā ñātā, ten'eva ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā paṭividitā'ti.

41027.commentary: (UDa) paṭividdhā taṇhā jānato passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti tañ'ca nirodhasaccaṃ sacchikiriy'ābhisamayavasena abhisamentena visayato kiccato ca ārammaṇato ca ārammaṇappaṭivedhena asammohappaṭivedhena ca paṭividdhaṃ, yathāpariññ'ābhisamayavasena dukkhasaccaṃ, bhāvan'ābhisamayavasena maggasaccañ'ca asammohato paṭividdhaṃ hoti, evaṃ pahān'ābhisamayavasena asammohato ca paṭividdhā taṇhā hoti. evañ'ca cattāri saccāni yathābhūtaṃ ariyamaggapaññāya jānato passato bhav'ādīsu natabhūtā taṇhā n'atthi, tadabhāve sabbassa'pi kilesavaṭṭassa abhāvo, tato'va kammavipākavaṭṭānaṃ asambhavo'y'evā'ti evaṃ bhagavā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anavasesa-vaṭṭadukkha-vūpasama-hetubhūtaṃ amatamahānibbānassa ānubhāvaṃ pakāsesi.

examples.text: duddasaṃ anataṃ nāma, na hi saccaṃ sudassanaṃ, paṭividdhā taṇhā jānato, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.
ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ… ucchinnā bhavataṇhā, khīṇā bhavanetti, n'atth'idāni punabbhavo'ti.

41028.meaning2: who acquired the understanding of a solitary Buddha

41030.commentary: (ANa) paṭivinayo'ti hi paṭivinayavatthūnam'pi paṭivinayakāraṇānam'pi etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, tadubhayam'pi idha vaṭṭati.

examples.text: nava'y'ime, bhikkhave, āghātapaṭivinayā. katame nava? anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut'ettha labbhā'ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
kāmasaññānaṃ pariññā akkhātā, kāmapipāsānaṃ paṭivinayo akkhāto, kāmavitakkānaṃ samugghāto akkhāto, kāmapariḷāhānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto?

41031.meaning1: cause for driving out; means of removal

41032.meaning1: basis for driving out; object for removal

examples.text: iti kira, bho, rūpaṃ anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṅkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṃ anattā, anattakatāni kammāni kam'attānaṃ phusissantī'ti. paṭivinītā kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, tatra tatra dhammesu.

41034.meaning1: should be driven out; should be dispelled; could be removed

examples.text: ime kho, āvuso, pañca āghātapaṭivinayā, yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo'ti.

41035.meaning1: drives out; dispels; gets rid of
41035.synonym: paṭivinodeti, panudati, panudeti, panūdati, vinodayati, vinodeti

examples.text: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā yāguyā. katame pañca? khuddaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ paṭivineti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, ām'āvasesaṃ pāceti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā yāguyā'ti.
nava'y'ime, bhikkhave, āghātapaṭivinayā. katame nava? anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut'ettha labbhā'ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.

41036.meaning1: having driven out; having dispelled; having got rid of

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivinetvā evaṃ imaṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyyan'ti.

so kho ahaṃ, bhante, aññatr'eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'y'eva kālaṅ'kato.

41039.meaning1: should be driven out; should be dispelled; should be removed; should be assuaged
41039.meaningLit: to cause to be driven back
41039.commentary: (VISMa) mettāyantena paṭighaṃ paṭivinodetabban'ti ettha keci pana upacārajjhānaṃ sampādetvā'ti atthaṃ vadanti, tesaṃ upacārajjhānato vuṭṭhānam'pi icchitabbaṃ siyā vuṭṭhahitvā'ti vuttattā. pubbe tasmiṃ puggale asatiyā amanasikārena paṭighaṃ anuppādentassa sādhāraṇato taṃ vikkhambhetvā jhānassa uppādanaṃ, samāpajjanañ'ca vuttaṃ. idāni pana taṃ anussarantassa'pi manasi karontassa'pi yathā paṭighaṃ na uppajjati, taṃ vidhiṃ dassetuṃ idaṃ vuttaṃ taṃ puggalaṃ mettāyantena paṭighaṃ vinodetabban'ti.

examples.text: cundassa, ānanda, kammāraputtassa evaṃ vippaṭisāro paṭivinodetabbo.

imassa ca atthassa āvibhāvatthaṃ, pañc'ime, āvuso, āghātapaṭivinayā. yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinodetabbo'ti (a. ni. 5.162) idaṃ pañcakanipāte āghātapaṭivinayasuttaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.

41040.grammar: pr, caus of pati vi √nud, trans (+acc)
41040.meaning1: drives out; dispels; removes; gets rid (of)
41040.synonym: paṭivineti, panudati, panudeti, panūdati, vitarati, vinayati, vineti, vinodayati, vinodeti

examples.text: tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañ'c'eva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañ'ca uttānī karonti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.

41041.meaning1: having driven out; having dispelled; having removed; having got rid (of)
41041.meaning2: having dispelled, having removed, having gotten rid of

examples.text: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti

so aparena samayena rūpānaṃ'y'eva samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā rūpataṇhaṃ pahāya rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihareyya.

41044.meaning1: sees deeply back (into); sees repeatedly in detail; understands with frequent insight

examples.text: asaṃhīraṃ asaṃkuppan'ti idaṃ vipassanā-paṭivipassanā-dassan'atthaṃ vuttaṃ. vipassanā hi rāg'ādīhi na saṃhīrati na saṃkuppatī'ti asaṃhīraṃ asaṃkuppaṃ, taṃ anubrūhaye vaḍḍheyya, paṭivipasseyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

41045.meaning1: repeated observation; (or) insight into previous insights
41045.meaning2: insight into past insight (as impermanent, etc.)

examples.text: iminā diṭṭh'ārammaṇā taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhiyo kathitā. vipassanāya paṭivipassanākāle viya pacchimadiṭṭhiyā purimadiṭṭhiggahaṇakāle evaṃ hoti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dakkho goghātako vā goghātak'antevāsī vā gāviṃ vadhitvā cātummahāpathe bilaso paṭivibhajitvā nisinno assa
imesaṃ pana, tapassi, tiṇṇaṃ daṇḍānaṃ evaṃ paṭivibhattānaṃ evaṃ paṭivisiṭṭhānaṃ katamaṃ daṇḍaṃ nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto mahāsāvajjataraṃ paññapeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso… musāvādā paṭivirato pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato samphappalāpā paṭivirato anabhijjhālu abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhiko.
idha cunda ekacco pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī viharati

yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato catūhi vacīduccaritehi ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāvācā ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
yaṃnūna mayaṃ sabbaso nivāpabhojanā paṭivirameyyāma, bhayabhogā paṭiviratā araññ'āyatanāni ajjhogāhetvā vihareyyāmā'ti.
te sabbaso nivāpabhojanā paṭiviramiṃsu, bhayabhogā paṭiviratā araññ'āyatanāni ajjhogāhetvā vihariṃsu.

41058.meaning1: opposes; is against; is averse; is hostile (to)

examples.text: so uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anurujjhati, alābhe paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ yasaṃ anurujjhati, ayase paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ pasaṃsaṃ anurujjhati, nindāya paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ sukhaṃ anurujjhati, dukkhe paṭivirujjhati.
sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, ananuruddh'āppaṭiviruddhass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā, na sā niṭṭhā anuruddhappaṭiviruddhassā'ti.
ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhavadiṭṭhiṃ allīnā bhavadiṭṭhiṃ upagatā bhavadiṭṭhiṃ ajjhositā, vibhavadiṭṭhiyā te paṭiviruddhā.

tasmā pañcame vā sattame vā divase puna tattha cāretuṃ vaṭṭati, ettakena hi tiṇam'pi paṭiviruhati, udakam'pi pasīdati. ayaṃ pana imaṃ pañcāhikavāraṃ vā satt'āhikavāraṃ vā na jānāti, divase divase rakkhitaṭṭhāne'y'eva rakkhati.

41066.commentary: (DNa) pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhan'ti sāyaṃ gahitaṭṭhānaṃ pāto pakkaṃ hoti, puna virūḷhaṃ paṭipākatikam'eva gahitaṭṭhānaṃ na paññāyati.

examples.text: yaṃ taṃ sāyaṃ sāyam'āsāya āharanti, pāto taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ. yaṃ taṃ pāto pātarāsāya āharanti, sāyaṃ taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ, n'āpadānaṃ paññāyati.
imesaṃ pana, tapassi, tiṇṇaṃ daṇḍānaṃ evaṃ paṭivibhattānaṃ evaṃ paṭivisiṭṭhānaṃ katamaṃ daṇḍaṃ nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto mahāsāvajjataraṃ paññapeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā
atha kho, bhikkhave, kāḷī dāsī bhinnena sīsena lohitena galantena paṭivissakānaṃ ujjhāpesi, passath'ayye, soratāya kammaṃ, passath'ayye, nivātāya kammaṃ, passath'ayye, upasantāya kammaṃ!
api ca mayaṃ taṃ sarāma, kiṃ nu kho mahāsamaṇo n'āgacchatī'ti? khādanīyassa ca bhojanīyassa ca te paṭiviṃso ṭhapito'ti.

41076.meaning1: to attend (to); to look after; to inspect

examples.text: brāhmaṇagahapatikānam'pi tasmiṃ samaye na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā bāhirāni vā kamm'antāni paṭivekkhituṃ.

41077.commentary: (MNa) ahutvā sambhontī'ti iminā udayaṃ passati. hutvā paṭiventī'ti iminā vayaṃ passati.

examples.text: ty'āssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. so evaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ kira'me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī'ti.
ārocayāmi vo, bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo, bhikkhave, mā vo sāmaññ'atthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññ'attho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye
tena hi tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ idh'eva tāva hotha, yāv'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭivedemī'ti.
sampannaṃ sālikedāraṃ, suvā bhuñjanti kosiya, paṭivedemi te brahme, na ne vāretum'ussahe.

41082.meaning2: having made known, having reformed, having announced

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsikāsatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi. ten'ev'antaravassena parinibbāyi.

evaṃ, devā'ti kho dīgho kārāyano rañño pasenadissa kosalassa paṭissutvā bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa paṭivedesi, yuttāni kho te, deva, bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni. yassa'dāni kālaṃ maññasī'ti.
evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho
iti kho, bhikkhave, yāvatā saññāsamāpatti tāvatā aññāpaṭivedho

41088.meaning1: will destroy; will put an end (to); will terminate

examples.text: iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāma navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāma yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti

41089.meaning1: we will destroy; we will put an end (to); we will terminate
41089.commentary: (MNt) purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmī'ti purāṇaṃ abhuttapaccayā uppajjanakavedanaṃ paṭihanissāmi.

examples.text: iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāma navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāma yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti

41090.grammar: fut 1st sg of paṭihaṅkhati, irreg form of paṭihanissati, trans (+acc)

41090.commentary: (NIDD1a) purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmī'ti purāṇavedanaṃ nāma abhuttapaccayā uppajjanakavedanā, taṃ paṭihanissāmī'ti āhāreti.

examples.text: iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro ca.
